architectureSummary: React + Mantine e-commerce architecture for Stride premium shoe brand. Uses Mantine's component system with centralized theme configuration. Implements client-side cart persistence via CartContext with localStorage. Product data stored in mockProducts.js, reusable content in siteContent.js. Page components in src/pages/ compose section components for modular development. Common components handle shared UI patterns (ProductCard, RatingStars). Product-specific components manage gallery, variants, and selection controls. Cart components handle item management and order summary. All components follow PascalCase naming with mobile-first responsive design.
